text:
Linh T.: RFC follow-up: propose a compact 'circuit aggregator' to reduce rollback flapping. idea: shrink signals to a small, composable set and add local/global agreement to avoid single-point failures. thoughts?
Maya P.: sounds promising. which signals are core vs advisory? need to protect product metrics from false positives.
Alex R.: core = 5xx rate, p95 latency, infra failures. model-quality should be advisory unless paired with infra/latency. keep math simple.
Sasha K.: agree. recommend adding metadata for each signal: {name,type:trigger|advisory,confidence,sample_rate,version} so we can evolve safely.
Linh T.: proposer sketch: circuit_score S = 0.55*err + 0.3*norm(p95) + 0.1*qual_flag + 0.05*infra_flag. norm(p95)=clamp((p95-120)/380,0,1). smoothing: exp alpha=0.25 over 90s, hold 45s after action.
ops-bot: live snapshot canary:c-77 err=0.018 p95=310ms infra_faults=0 qual_regress=false sample_rate_metrics=1%
Frank O.: central aggregator ok but SPoF risk. propose hybrid: each node calculates S_local; central S_global; trigger only if S_local>t_local AND S_global>t_global, or if S_global>hard_cutoff.
Maya P.: product note: human-facing quality signals lag; automatic rollback only when quality + infra/latency coincide. otherwise send advisory page.
Alex R.: how do we test thresholds? need replay harness.
Sasha K.: I'll build a 'what-if' runner to replay 30m of traffic into the aggregator in dry-run mode; it should produce explainable traces per decision.
Linh T.: ingestion contract example: ```json
{"signal_name":"p95_latency_ms","type":"trigger","value":310.0,"confidence":0.95,"sample_rate":0.01,"schema_version":"1"}
```
Alex R.: include confidence and sample_rate in contract. also record raw counters for audit.
Frank O.: ops runbook: local proxy fallback, config to force pause/unpause, incident escalation flow. will draft.
ops-bot: note: quality evals sampled at 0.25% for canaries; expensive full-eval jobs available on demand.
Linh T.: rollout plan: 1) prototype aggregator + local proxy in shadow (2w), 2) schema + test harness (1w), 3) ops runbook + kill-switch (1w), 4) 2-week shadow with observability + audit logs, then enable automated actions.
deploy-bot: shadow run event: canary:c-77 circuit_score=0.72 -> recommended pause (not executed in shadow).
Maya P.: LGTM. please add dashboard panels: S, components, smoothing history, and 'why-pause' links.
Alex R.: will pair on prototype. include playbook link in PR.
Linh T.: thanks everyone. I'll open PR with proto config, signal schema draft, and checklist.
deploy-bot: manual note: if automated pause happens, deploy-bot will annotate rollout and include last 5 contributing signals.
